blocks.text: DARAGA, Albay — Daraga’s new 20-megavolt-ampere (MVA) Cullat Substation was blessed and energized on Friday, Nov. 20, marking a major step toward improving power distribution capacity in the municipality and other areas in Albay’s 2nd District. The project was initiated through the efforts of Ako Bicol Party-list, with funding provided through national government assistance to the Albay Electric Cooperative (ALECO). READ: Upgraded ALECO substation unveiled in Ligao City, Albay Ako Bicol Party-list Rep. Alfredo “Pido” Garbin Jr. said the facility is expected to help meet the growing electricity demand of the Bicol International Airport and accommodate future investments in Daraga, Camalig, […]...
